description: Duplicates a slide (batchUpdate duplicateObject) — the copy, with all its elements and speaker notes, lands immediately after the original and its new objectId comes back in the reply. Works on any page element id too (the copy lands on the same slide, slightly offset). Move the copy with move_slides afterwards if needed.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

slide_object_id.description: The object id of the slide (or page element) to duplicate.

name: duplicate_slide
title: Duplicate a slide
